result.summary: The page is mostly visually intact, but the bottom navigation has a missing icon on the Orders tab, which is a clear visual/functional defect.

issues.description: The Orders tab in the bottom navigation bar shows only the label text with no visible icon above it, unlike Home, Search, and Profile which all have icons.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g., a list, receipt, or clipboard icon) above the Orders label to match the other navigation items and improve usability.
